title: Request IDs, cache kill-switch, baseUrl validation, dead code
description: Four concerns that share files and vocabulary: X-Request-Id tracing (new ids util, client, HttpError, test), a CACHE_ENABLED kill-switch (config, defaults, cache, tests, plus a test helper that must now pass the new field), baseUrl validation in the HttpClient constructor (same files as tracing), and removal of an unused time helper.
